messages:
Rohit (FinOps): Flagging anomaly: morning export shows ~$22,410 funneled into project 'nightshift-pool' for 2026-03-25 02:00-05:00 UTC. Looks like fallback labels triggered again. billing-bot: Alert: Billing concentration anomaly detected for BA-12345  project 'nightshift-pool' exceeded threshold (last 24h). Elena (Billing Ops): Can someone attach the CSV extract and ledger ids? Need to see whether these are preemptible credits or full-price usage. Marcus (Infra): Uploaded extract: https://console.cloud.google.com/billing/exports/BA-12345?file=nightshift-2026-03-25.csv. Quick scan: many rows show label_team = null and label_fallback_pool = 'nightshift-pool'. Zoe (ML Platform): We pushed a safeguard change last week that sets fallback_pool to 'nightshift-pool' during a canary; if kubelet metadata lagged, unlabeled pods ended up matched. Iris (CostOps): That matches the sudden spike. Impact: two product teams show budget overruns and one customer-facing project underreported. Rohit (FinOps): What's the recommended remediation? Elena (Billing Ops): Two steps: 1) retro-map rows to likely owners and create internal credit memos; 2) revert the canary fallback or change it to 'unallocated' until we harden metadata propagation. Marcus (Infra): SQL I ran against billing_export.gcp_costs to surface suspects:

SELECT usage_start_time, project_id, ledger_id, label_team, label_fallback_pool, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM `billing_export.gcp_costs`
WHERE invoice_month='2026-03'
  AND DATE(usage_start_time)='2026-03-25'
  AND (label_team IS NULL OR label_team = '')
  AND label_fallback_pool = 'nightshift-pool'
GROUP BY usage_start_time, project_id, ledger_id, label_team, label_fallback_pool
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 200;

Marcus (Infra): Topline: project_id=nightshift-pool cost=22410.67 across ~180 ledger rows. Elena (Billing Ops): OK  please produce CSV with columns ledger_id, suggested_owner (best-effort from scheduler logs), cost, usage_start_time and upload. Put in Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.internal/finance/nightshift-maps/3161234567.csv Marcus (Infra): Done. Uploaded mapping now. Zoe (ML Platform): I'll open PR to change fallback_pool -> 'unallocated' and add a webhook that rejects unlabeled GPU pods during canary. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/ml-platform/patches/PR-845 Iris (CostOps): Recommend we approve a one-time reallocation up to $25k while we validate the mapping. Rohit (FinOps): Approving reallocation up to $25k pending mapping QA and accounting memo. Elena (Billing Ops): Copying internal memo template  fill out and I'll run through accounting:
- invoice_ref: 2026-03-25-BA-12345
- affected_ledger_ids: [..]
- proposed_owner: team_name
- amount: numeric
- justification: fallback label applied during canary when pod metadata delayed

Elena (Billing Ops): Creating ticket BILL-4788 to track this; assigned to Marcus, Zoe, Iris; severity P2. billing-bot: Action logged: ticket BILL-4788 created, watchers: Rohit, Elena. Iris (CostOps): Also requesting an alert update: notify #finance if >$1.5k lands in 'nightshift-pool' within 2h. Marcus (Infra): Will include kubelet timestamps and autoscaler events in mapping to help forensics. Zoe (ML Platform): Also adding an integration test to the canary pipeline to simulate metadata lag. Marcus (Infra): After mapping QA, Elena please run reallocation script and paste journal entry IDs here. Elena (Billing Ops): Will do. Rohit (FinOps): No objections. Approved, ticket created, fallback change in PR. Closing note: please post journal ids when complete so finance can reconcile. :thumbsup:
